ANTIQUITIES ORDINANCE
Order

BY virtue of powers vested in me under Sub-section 39“a” of the Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) as amended by theAct, No. 24 of 1988, I, Minister of Higher Education and Cultural Affairs, do, by this Order, appoint the members referredto in the Schedule here to the Advisory Committee on Archaeology as effective for a period the 01st of June 2018 to 30thof May 2020.
Dr. WIJEYADASA RAJAPAKSHA,
President's Counsel,Minister of Higher Education and Cultural Affairs.
Ministry of Higher Education and Cultural Affairs,17th May 2018.
